sections.Profile:
The "Mars God of War" pinball machine, manufactured by Gottlieb in March 1981, is notable for being one of the early widebody machines and the first Gottlieb game to feature speech. Designed by John Buras with artwork by David Moore, it offers a sci-fi theme featuring intricate infinity lighting and a distinctive red and black color scheme.
